model.title: Convention area of the North Pacific Fisheries Commission: management, conservation and control measures

summary.text: This proposal aims to establish rules for managing fish stocks and preventing illegal fishing in the North Pacific Ocean, setting out how fishing activities would be monitored and controlled in that region. It seeks to ensure sustainable fishing practices and conservation of marine resources through standardized management measures.
